planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; wiring preserved: LM35 on A1, button on D2, TM1637 with CLK=D4 and DIO=D5.
Button on D2 is configured with pullup=true and active_high=false so that the model boolean becomes true when the button is pressed.
Analog input scale/offset are not specified in the prompt; the application/model must define the LM35 conversion into degC (including units and ADC scaling).

TM1637 number is configured for leading_zero=false; exact temperature formatting/rounding (e.g., number of decimals, clipping behavior, and whether negative temperatures are possible) is a model concern not specified in the prompt.

Serial protocol details (line format, exact text, and report cadence) are not specified beyond '持续输出两者'; this proposal uses one serial channel gated by a model boolean trigger and reports two numeric fields (current and max) with unit degC.
Control period set to 10 ms as a safe default for responsiveness and display/button handling; business timing (3 seconds max-display) must be implemented in the SysML model using elapsed_ms deltas.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Button: press to display historical maximum temperature for 3 seconds

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display current temperature by default; shows historical maximum while button-triggered display is active

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Serial report gate: continuously output both current temperature and historical maximum temperature (with the same cadence as the model’s reporting cadence)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个温度监控与历史极值显示系统，使用 LM35（A1）、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2 和串口。系统实时读取温度并保存运行以来的最高温度；默认显示当前温度，按下按钮后显示历史最高温度 3 秒，然后恢复当前温度，同时串口持续输出两者。
